name: almagest
description: One Obsidian vault for the wiki, the sessions, and the changes of your work, shared by Claude Code and Codex.

args:
#!/bin/sh
# The almagest launcher, made by `make pin` from internal/release/launcher.sh: do not edit.
# It runs the almagest binary of this plugin's version, 11.0.0. When that binary is not
# installed yet, it downloads it once from the plugin's own GitHub release, checks its
# sha256 against the checksums below, which the plugin pins, and installs it under
# ~/.almagest/bin/. It writes nowhere else, and needs no sudo.
#   ALMAGEST_BIN          runs that binary instead; nothing is downloaded.
#   ALMAGEST_HOME         the machine folder, ~/.almagest by default.
#   ALMAGEST_NO_DOWNLOAD  set to 1, it never downloads.
version='11.0.0'
checksums='391c05b3ed2f8e07c47d2c0986658a7db0ad1312aa0425a3fbe8519a3dad16ee  almagest-11.0.0-darwin-amd64
97efcae63b453242f032fcda142cb8e42d2a72dd538184ec3f3754015aae1b89  almagest-11.0.0-darwin-arm64
68cf733ddfcae38c9e07fbcaf1143febd890895d5c533e61ec62905361384827  almagest-11.0.0-linux-amd64
16a48485e57c6a798caabf469934d11224466a87d8de839ab16665ac87b78827  almagest-11.0.0-linux-arm64'

missing() {
	why=$1
	shift
	if [ "$1" = hook ]; then
		# A hook never breaks a session; the session start says what is missing.
		if [ "$2" = session-start ]; then
			echo "almagest: the almagest tools and hooks are off: $why."
		fi
		cat >/dev/null
		exit 0
	fi
	echo "almagest: $why." >&2
	exit 1
}

if [ -n "$ALMAGEST_BIN" ]; then
	if [ -x "$ALMAGEST_BIN" ]; then
		exec "$ALMAGEST_BIN" "$@"
	fi
	missing "ALMAGEST_BIN names $ALMAGEST_BIN, which is no executable file" "$@"
fi
home=$ALMAGEST_HOME
if [ -z "$home" ]; then
	home=$HOME/.almagest
fi
bin=$home/bin/$version/almagest
if [ -x "$bin" ]; then
	exec "$bin" "$@"
fi
if [ "$ALMAGEST_NO_DOWNLOAD" = 1 ]; then
	missing "almagest $version is not installed at $bin, and ALMAGEST_NO_DOWNLOAD is 1" "$@"
fi

case $(uname -s) in
Darwin) os=darwin ;;
Linux) os=linux ;;
*) missing "almagest has no release for $(uname -s)" "$@" ;;
esac
case $(uname -m) in
arm64 | aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
x86_64 | amd64) arch=amd64 ;;
*) missing "almagest has no release for $(uname -m)" "$@" ;;
esac
asset=almagest-$version-$os-$arch
want=$(printf '%s\n' "$checksums" | awk -v a="$asset" '$2 == a { print $1 }')
if [ -z "$want" ]; then
	missing "this plugin pins no almagest $version for $os-$arch; set ALMAGEST_BIN to a binary of your own" "$@"
fi
if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
	missing "curl is not installed, so almagest $version cannot be downloaded" "$@"
fi
base=$ALMAGEST_RELEASE_BASE
proto==https
if [ -z "$base" ]; then
	base=https://github.com/nathanaday/almagest/releases/download
else
	# Only tests set the base. The checksums still decide what installs.
	proto=all
fi
url=$base/$version/$asset
mkdir -p "$home/bin/$version" || missing "cannot make $home/bin/$version" "$@"
tmp=$home/bin/$version/.download.$$
trap 'rm -f "$tmp" "$home/bin/.link.$$"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
if ! curl -fsSL --proto "$proto" --retry 2 -o "$tmp" "$url"; then
	missing "the download of $url failed" "$@"
fi
if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
	got=$(shasum -a 256 "$tmp" | awk '{ print $1 }')
else
	got=$(sha256sum "$tmp" | awk '{ print $1 }')
fi
if [ "$got" != "$want" ]; then
	missing "the download of $url has sha256 $got, not the $want that this plugin pins, so nothing was installed" "$@"
fi
chmod 755 "$tmp" && mv -f "$tmp" "$bin" || missing "cannot install $bin" "$@"
# ~/.almagest/bin/almagest names the binary last installed, for the Obsidian plugin and a shell.
ln -s "$version/almagest" "$home/bin/.link.$$" && mv -f "$home/bin/.link.$$" "$home/bin/almagest"
line="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) installed almagest $version ($os-$arch) at $bin, sha256 $got, from $url"
echo "$line" >>"$home/install.log"
echo "almagest: $line" >&2
exec "$bin" "$@"

interface.shortDescription: One vault for the wiki, the sessions, and the changes.
interface.longDescription: Keep what you know and what your agents do in one Obsidian vault, with a reviewed change for every wiki edit and a session document for every agent session.
defaultPrompt: Use the almagest skill to orient me in this vault.
